item.title: Undertone 1.33.4
item.description:
• Up next no longer drops meetings when an earlier Google Calendar check covered fewer days: each check now remembers how far ahead it read.

Undertone 1.33.3

  • Up next in a space shows that space's meetings: work spaces skip events from personal calendars.
  • Work meetings no longer disappear from Up next when the Google Calendar check comes back empty.

Undertone 1.33.2

  • Up next looks a week ahead: on a quiet weekend or evening it shows the next day you have meetings, like Monday, instead of "Nothing scheduled".
  • Your calendar is kept up to date in the background, so Up next is ready when you open Home instead of waiting on "Checking Google…". Google Calendar is checked about every half hour, and Refresh checks right away.

Undertone 1.33.1

  • Elaborate now expands the answer you just got. Before, it could pick up an unrelated meeting that happened to use words like "detail" or "example" and elaborate on that instead.
  • Short follow-ups such as "why?" or "tell me more about that" now read the meetings behind your previous question.

Undertone 1.33.0

  • New here? Undertone now starts with a sample meeting under Meetings: a made-up standup with its recap, action items, explained terms and transcript, so you can see what you get after a call. Delete it whenever you like.
  • A Get started checklist on Tasks and Home: open the sample, connect your calendar, record your first meeting, ask a question, run a recipe, import your org chart, set up a team and connect a work tool. Each step ticks itself off when you do it, and you can hide the list.
